exposure: placental DNA methylation (HIVEP3 gene shore region, BCL11B gene open sea region)
outcome: pro-inflammatory proteins in cord blood (interleukin-6, interleukin-8, tumor necrosis factor a (TNFa), intercellular adhesion molecule 1, serum amyloid A (SAA), C-reactive protein)
cohort: The study included 249 mother-child dyads from the Harvard Epigenetic Birth Cohort.
finding: Differential placental DNA methylation of loci in the HIVEP3 gene was associated with TNFa protein levels in cord blood, and loci in the BCL11B gene were associated with SAA protein levels in cord blood, suggesting a role in neonatal acute immune response.
mod_finding: TNFa protein levels in cord blood were associated with mode of delivery.
birth_weight: measured and associated with SAA levels
gest_age: measured and associated with TNFa and SAA levels
